programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the premiere of It's A Beautiful World, Jeff Fuchs joins a team of doctors as they navigate the vast waterways of the Amazon River to deliver vital healthcare to remote Indigenous communities. Set in the tri-border region between Colombia, Brazil, and Peru, this episode offers a powerful look at medicine, resilience, and human connection in one of the most isolated places on Earth.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Jeff ventures deep into the Amazon rainforest to explore a secluded eco-lodge committed to sustainable living. He visits a monkey sanctuary working to rehabilitate rescued wildlife and ends the day by joining locals in a spirited community soccer tournament—celebrating the role of sport, conservation, and joy in jungle life.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Two years after his first Amazon expedition, Jeff Fuchs is invited back by his friend Juan Alan Muñoz for an extraordinary journey into one of the most remote and untouched parts of the rainforest. After arriving by cargo plane in the outpost of La Chorrera, Jeff boards Juan’s newly outfitted hospital boat—but before the journey can begin, he is summoned to meet the regional Chief of the Igara Paraná. In a powerful exchange of trust and tradition, Jeff offers gifts of maple syrup and receives the Chief’s blessing to travel the sacred waterways.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Before departing La Chorrera, Jeff takes time to explore Juan Alan Muñoz’s remarkable floating hospital—a lifeline for remote Amazonian communities. Onboard, Jeff witnesses eye surgeries, dental procedures, and vital health and nutrition services being delivered to those with no other access to medical care. As the boat prepares for its 400-mile journey, this episode offers an inspiring look at grassroots healthcare in one of the most inaccessible regions on Earth.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: As the floating hospital leaves La Chorrera, Jeff arrives in the village of Providencia—home to the Bora people, whose culture is deeply tied to the sacred triad of coca, tobacco, and cassava. Unexpectedly, Jeff stumbles upon a rare and powerful event: a regional summit where Indigenous chiefs from across the Amazon have gathered to discuss peace, territory, and cultural preservation—an event many call the “G7 of the Amazon.” Following tradition, Jeff must await an invitation to meet the local chief. While respectfully waiting, he spends a day with a local fisherman, navigating the winding rivers and gaining insight into traditional fishing practices passed down through generations.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Jeff is finally summoned to the Maloka—the ceremonial longhouse—by the Chief of the Bora people. In a moment of deep cultural significance, the Chief offers his blessing and invites Jeff to witness a traditional gathering of the entire village and visiting Amazonian leaders. As sacred dances unfold in rhythmic celebration, the air is filled with the earthy scent of Mambe being prepared—coca leaves ground and mixed in an ancestral ritual that binds community, history, and spirit. It's a rare and intimate glimpse into the heart of Indigenous ceremony in the Amazon.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Throughout the journey, one sacred element has remained constant—Mambe, a traditional preparation of coca leaf that lies at the heart of Indigenous Amazonian life. In this episode, Jeff meets “Happy,” a spirited local who guides him through the complete Mambe-making process, from leaf to ritual. Through the voices of elders and community members, the episode explores the cultural, spiritual, and communal importance of Mambe—revealing its role not just as a sacred tradition, but as a living symbol of identity, respect, and connection to the land.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: As Jeff’s journey along the Igara Paraná draws to a close, the hospital boat enters the Putumayo River—edging ever closer to the self-isolated Pupuna tribe. The first stop along this new stretch is Puerto Arica, a lively river town hosting an international soccer tournament that brings together traders, travelers, and communities from across the Amazon. Amid the weekend of celebration, Jeff is invited on a night-time caiman hunt beneath a moonlit sky, and joins a local tradesman for an early morning fishing trip followed by a rustic riverside breakfast. It’s a brief but colorful pause before the journey continues deeper into isolation.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: While anchored for an overnight stay along the Putumayo River, Jeff and the crew are approached by a group of Israelites—members of a little-known, non-Indigenous community that has settled deep in the Amazon to prepare for a prophesied seven-year drought. What begins as a surreal encounter takes an unexpected turn when the group requests medical help for the ailing grandson of their community leader. This urgent plea grants Jeff and the team unprecedented access to a secretive world rarely seen by outsiders—revealing a unique blend of spiritual belief, isolation, and survivalist purpose hidden deep within the jungle.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: After weeks navigating remote rivers, dense jungle, and unexpected encounters, Jeff and the floating hospital team finally reach their most distant and mysterious destination: the territory of the self-isolated Pupuna. What follows is a delicate and respectful moment of contact, made possible only through trust built over years and the careful guidance of local leaders. With no cameras allowed beyond a certain point, Jeff experiences a rare glimpse into a community untouched by modern influence—where ancient ways of life endure in harmony with the forest. It is a quiet, humbling encounter that marks the emotional peak of the Amazon journey.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the season finale of It’s a Beautiful World, Jeff looks back on the unforgettable meals and spontaneous encounters and places that shaped his journey through the Amazon. This episode captures the emotional heart of the expedition.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World

As sacred dances unfold in rhythmic celebration, the air is filled with the earthy scent of Mambe being prepared—coca leaves ground and mixed in an ancestral ritual that binds community, history, and spirit. It's a rare and intimate glimpse into the heart of Indigenous ceremony in the Amazon.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Luego de que Cristóbal se enterara la verdad acerca de que su Ana era la misma Ana de la historia de amor de Guillermo, rompe su relación con ella, por lo que Marilda y Guillermo encuentran la oportunidad de volver con sus respectivos amores. Pero Onofre le aconseja a Cristóbal que no se separe, y vuelve al ruedo cuando le perdona a Ana la mentira, y le pide nuevamente que se case con él. Mientras que Venancio continúa en la búsqueda del asesino por el envenenado del acotamiento, otra muerte sucumbe al condominio: Diego, el vecino del cuarto piso, apareció sin vida en su apartamento por presunta muerte natural.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri tienen su día de amor. Juan Diego está en la casa de Bienvenida buscando a Yubiri. Bienvenida se preocupa porque ella pensaba que estaba en la agencia. Pero entonces todos piensan que está con Solymar pero esta llega en ese preciso momento buscándola. Fabián | Junior | Olegario y Pastor están jugando dominó. Fabián vuelve con lo de Finita y de repente todos se le quedan viendo porque tiene dos tremendos cachos. Finita le cuenta a Ana lo de Armando.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le dice a Magdalena que con ella es diferente que se está enamorando pero ella no le cree nada y piensa que con todas es igual. Valentina le cuenta a Epicúreo toda la historia de su hija y le confirma que es Julieta Fernández, la hija de Efraín y Ana Belén. Ana habla por celular con Julieta y le dice que hubo un error, que ella no hablo con el doctor Salas, que es su mamá pero Julieta no confía plenamente y luego cuando llega a la casa encuentra unas fotos raras y se dedica a averiguar que es lo que pasa. Ricardo acuerda con Julieta que publicará en “La Deslenguada” que lo de Magdalena y Gabriel fueron rumores infundados pero con una condición, que vaya a la casa con Jamer y le averigüe todo sobre Magdalena Miranda.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo busca consejo en Manuela tras la muerte de Celia. Ella le sugiere mudarse con sus hijos, mientras Jade insulta a Benjamín tratándolo como Néstor Cordido. En el cementerio, Elizabeth y Moisés sufren por la pérdida. María del Pilar anuncia su embarazo a René y Gustavo, generando dudas sobre la paternidad de Marcelo. Finalmente, Hortensia y Benjamín planean viajar con Glorita, y Cecilia regresa al hato para organizar el futuro de sus sobrinos tras hallar sobres escritos por Celia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa expulsa furiosamente a Consuelo y Blanca del hospital. Carmen Rosa cuenta a Rosa que aceptó la ayuda de Erasto por desesperación. José Luis enfrenta a Erasto en la fiesta del gimnasio y es expulsado por seguridad. Carlos propone a Marisela ayudarla con su alcoholismo. Vilma orquesta el secuestro de Leticia mediante delincuentes contratados. Alejandro le confiesa a José Luis que se mudará a casa de los Alamo para estar cerca de Rosa. Natalia pacta con criminales para hacerle daño a alguien, complicando aún más la red de intrigas.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Enzo le dice a Vicky que quiere terminar su relación porque está enamorado de Milagros. Ella trata de convencerlo diciéndole todo el amor que siente por él, pero Enzo insiste en estar enamorado de Milagros, entonces Victoria se desespera y le dice que va a luchar por él. Amada lo cita Germán a su casa y le ordena que realice un atentado en contra de Clemencia Talamonti Clemencia citó a Luis Francisco en un lugar rodeado de vagabundos, que es el sitio en donde la dejaron abandonada a ella.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Luís Francisco habla con Augusto, y le confiesa que todavía sigue enamorado de su esposa. Augusto, enfurecido al saber esto le dice que no lo quiere volver a ver. Luego, Luís Francisco habla con su madre, y ella le propone que tome lo que le pertenece de los Talamonti, y lo presiona por la deuda que tiene con un banco Italiano, pero él solamente quiere recuperar a Clemencia. De todos modos, Amada piensa encargarse de que los acreedores del banco Italiano le vayan a cobrar la deuda.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: La muerte imprevista de Diego sembró un dolor durísimo en Daniela, pero también dejó a la luz que las sospechas de su deceso recayeran sobre Pedro, quien continúa moviendo las fichas en las vidas de todos los vecinos del condominio. Tanto es así, que luego de que la autopsia determinara “muerte natural”, intenta convencer a Daniela para que no venda el apartamento. Ella no podrá afrontar el costo mensual por el crédito bancario que con su marido habían sacado para comprarlo, y Pedro le ofrece un préstamo. Con esto, y ante la inminente seguridad de que tampoco podrá pagárselo, querrá quedarse con el apartamento.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Todo el mundo comienza a preguntar y Freddy es el que le dice a todos que esa pareja está empatada. Briggite está que se muere y comienza a preguntar que como es eso de que Yubileisy está empatada con su Whisky. Bienvenida sigue diciéndoles cosas a Yubiri y a Wilker. Ellos están pensando en ellos y Briggite totalmente fuera de lugar. Freddy y Solymar están afuera de la casa de Bienvenida hablando de lo mismo. Freddy le dice que es su héroe. Todos se van y se queda Yubiri con Briggite.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Julieta se entera que no es hija de Ana Belén, por unos registros del hospital donde nació. Efraín y Ana Belén tratan de calmarla, pero no lo logran. Julieta se decide a irse de la casa, y Seis nueve le ofrece quedarse con Dilenis. Al día siguiente, Julieta se encuentra con Patricia, una monja que había ido a hacer un informe a ese barrio, y dos muchachos aparecen para acosarlas. Efraín habla con Valentina, para contarle lo sucedido, y ella le asegura que no fue quien le confesó eso a Julieta, cuando justo llega Ana Belén para hablar con Valentina. Nayarí decide contarle a Deibis que su tío es Gabriel León, pero a Deibis sólo le cae mal la noticia, ya que se había cruzado una vez con él, y no lo trató bien.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín intenta huir del país con Hortensia y Glorita, pero es arrestado en el aeropuerto por las autoridades y Ricardo. Katiuska queda al frente del emporio Tarifa. Romina persuade a María del Pilar de fingir su embarazo para casarse con Marcelo. Amparo defiende la inocencia de Benjamín, mientras Ricardo recrimina a Manuela por no avisarle sobre Glorita. La tensión aumenta tras la captura de Benjamín, quien niega su verdadera identidad ante la policía.

programme.title: Episodio 98
programme.desc: Eustoquio roba documentos clave del despacho de Rivero para vengarse de Erasto. Alejandro nota a Leticia extraña y vuelve con la policía. Carlos asombra a Alejandro con conocimientos de amor sin unión física. Rosa confiesa a Carmen Rosa que se casó con Junior y ella se horroriza al saber que es su hermano. Consuelo enfrenta a Erasto reprochándole haber regalado una hacienda a Carmen Rosa. Erasto se horroriza al saber que Rosa se casó con Junior. Leticia es secuestrada por dos delincuentes de su tienda.

Ahora los cuervos, liderados por la genio de las trampas Trixie, están decididos a que Moé se enfrente a su destino en el Tribunal de los Cuervos. Su única esperanza de absolución depende de que el Team Astro demuestre que actuó por ignorancia y no por malicia, y de que el Dr. Blunt demuestre que realmente es un brillante zoólogo y cirujano veterinario.

programme.desc: El ex Boina Verde, Justin Wise, cambia su vida de peligro por una placa de sheriff en un pueblo tranquilo en el corazón de las montañas Blue Ridge. Ahora más cerca de su ex esposa e hija, está listo para establecerse y abrazar una vida sin caos. Pero los problemas tienen una manera de seguirlo. Justo cuando comienza a adaptarse a la vida sencilla, un asesinato en la comunidad pone nerviosos a los residentes y reaviva una larga disputa entre dos de las familias más poderosas. A medida que Justin y sus ayudantes trabajan en el caso, se da cuenta de que hay más en su nuevo hogar de lo que parece. Los secretos se revelan y los motivos emergen, lo que lleva a Justin a una carrera contra el tiempo para resolver el caso antes de que la gente del pueblo tome la ley en sus propias manos.

programme.title: Río maldito
programme.desc: Río Maldito - Criado por un dentista ambulante después de que lincharan a su padre, un hombre regresa a casa solo para ser incriminado por la misma banda de bandidos por matar a un jugador.

programme.title: En el viejo Oklahoma
programme.desc: En 1906, en las tierras indias de Oklahoma, un vaquero lucha por los derechos de arrendamiento de petróleo contra un codicioso petrolero mientras una bonita maestra de escuela roba el corazón de ambos.

programme.title: Los buitres cavarán tu fosa
programme.desc: Los buitres cavarán tu fosa - Como el bandidaje se vuelve incontrolable poco después de la Guerra Civil Americana, la compañía de transportes Wells Fargo contrata a unos Pistoleros, para protegerse de las incursiones cada vez más frecuentes.

programme.title: La furia de Johnny Kid
programme.desc: Dos clanes familiares siempre han sido enemigos; pasan su tiempo odiándose y matándose entre ellos. La hija de la familia Campos y el hijo de la familia Mounter se enamoran, causando así más odio y muertes.

programme.title: Apache Kid
programme.desc: Unos forajidos atacan a una banda de colonos y matan a todos menos a una mujer embarazada que es rescatada por una banda de indios. La mujer muere al dar a luz, pero el jefe Oso Blanco adopta a su hijo varón, lo llama "Cielo Luminoso" y lo cría como hermano de su propio hijo, Lobo Negro.

programme.title: La muerte no cuenta los dólares
programme.desc: Lawrence White vuelve a Owell Rock para vengar la muerte de su padre. Para proteger su identidad y asegurar su venganza, cambia su nombre y contrata a otro hombre para que se haga pasar por él, iniciando un juego peligroso de engaños y justicia.

programme.title: 500 $, vivo o muerto
programme.desc: Un pie tierno se convierte en cazarrecompensas con la esperanza de labrarse un futuro mejor para él y su nuevo amor.

programme.title: Siete pistolas para Timothy
programme.desc: Timothy Benson, un joven intelectual e inexperto, hereda una mina de oro y se convierte en objetivo del bandido Rodrigo Rodríguez, que intenta arrebatársela por la fuerza. Sin experiencia en el oeste, Timothy debe confiar en su capataz y sus amigos para endurecerse y defender su herencia.

programme.title: Casta indomable
programme.desc: Un joven abogado muy brillante con un temperamento muy rápido viaja a Mission, una pequeña ciudad fronteriza de Texas para ajustar cuentas por el asesinato de su padre, un operador del servicio secreto a manos de traficantes de armas

programme.title: El pistolero de negro
programme.desc: En Tombstone, un nuevo sheriff promete limpiar el pueblo de forajidos como los hermanos O'Hara y es asistido por un extraño abogado que siempre lleva consigo dos grandes libros de leyes.

programme.title: Plomo sobre Dallas
programme.desc: La violencia estalla cuando unos hombres intentan apoderarse de las tierras de un ranchero para construir un nuevo ferrocarril.

programme.title: Sentencia de muerte
programme.desc: Cuatro hombres mataron al hermano de Django hace mucho tiempo.

programme.title: El 7 leguas
programme.desc: Rodolfo se apodera de “7 Leguas”, el famoso caballo de Pancho Villa, e intenta escapar. Una huida que comienza con un caballo legendario y que promete aventuras, tensión y sorpresas.

programme.title: El águila negra
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de sus dos hermanos y del padre de su novia, un hombre adopta la identidad del Águila Negra, un legendario bandido que roba para ayudar a los pobres. Mientras busca descubrir al responsable, se convierte en una figura misteriosa que lucha contra las injusticias y protege a los más necesitados.

programme.title: Se busca
programme.desc: En Nuevo México, la infeliz esposa de mediana edad de un sheriff ayuda a un preso condenado a escapar de la cárcel de su marido y se fuga con el joven y atractivo forajido a México, perseguido por la partida del sheriff.

programme.title: El Coyote
programme.desc: En 1848 los EEUU se anexionan California, los hispanos son ahora discriminados por los yanquis. Para acabar con los abusos Don César ordena a su hijo estudiante que regrese de Europa. Los lugareños se ríen de este ridículo dandi. Pero no todo es lo que parece.

programme.title: Shango: Pistola infalible
programme.desc: Tras el final de la Guerra Civil, un mayor despiadado mantiene a un pueblo aislado en la ignorancia para conservar su poder. Cuando el ranger Shango es acusado falsamente de asesinato, logra escapar y emprende una lucha contra el corrupto militar para liberar a los habitantes y revelar la verdad.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 25, 26, 27
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: Django y Sartana - El último duelo
programme.desc: Sartana, un joven pistolero de Dallas, llega a Black City haciéndose pasar por sheriff, con la misión de eliminar a Bud Willer, un peligroso bandido que no duda en asesinar a todo aquel que se le oponga.

programme.title: Llanto por un bandido
programme.desc: José María "El Tempranillo" huye de la justicia y se esconde en Sierra Morena. Allí, tras enfrentarse a peligros y desafíos, forja su destino como líder de un temido grupo de bandidos. De perseguido a leyenda, su nombre se convertirá en símbolo de rebeldía y aventura.

programme.title: Uno después de otro
programme.desc: Uno después de otro - Stan Ross, un pistolero con gafas, llega a Canyon City y se involucra con dos facciones enfrentadas después de que un empleado fuera asesinado por el banquero Jefferson durante un asalto fallido mientras robaba su propio banco.

programme.title: Los Largos Dias de la Venganza
programme.desc: Después de tres años de trabajos forzados, Ted Barnett se escapa de la cárcel para vengarse de los tres hombres que lo incriminaron.

programme.title: Tepepa
programme.desc: Tepepa - El líder guerrillero Tepepa y su banda luchan contra el jefe de policía, Cascorro.

programme.title: Una pistola para cien cruces
programme.desc: Un irlandés es asesinado en el salvaje Oeste. Su hijo Jimmy sale en busca de los asesinos de su padre, pero pronto cae en una emboscada de dos salteadores de caminos y es asesinado también.

programme.title: Pistoleros de Arizona
programme.desc: Un pistolero gana 5.000 dólares en una partida de póquer y se convierte en copropietario de un rancho. Antes de reclamar su parte, debe enfrentarse a un poderoso terrateniente corrupto que amenaza y expulsa a los pequeños agricultores para apoderarse del valle.

programme.title: El látigo negro contra los farsantes
programme.desc: Una banda de delincuentes adopta la identidad de «El Látigo Negro» para cometer delitos y poner al pueblo en su contra. Mientras su reputación se ve amenazada, el verdadero héroe deberá descubrir quiénes se esconden tras la máscara y demostrar la verdad.

programme.title: El río de las ánimas
programme.desc: Leonardo Moncada y su amigo Pedro llegan a caballo a Pueblo Viejo, una localidad que vive bajo el dominio del poderoso don Pedro Fonseca. Su llegada los adentra en un lugar marcado por el poder, las tensiones y las reglas impuestas por un hombre que controla el destino del pueblo.

programme.title: El hijo del Zorro
programme.desc: En tiempos del emperador Maximiliano, el hijo de Zorro lucha por los oprimidos en México. Tras un ataque rebelde en el que muere Don Herrera, su hija Conchita escapa con ayuda del enmascarado, que se une a la revolución contra el tiránico gobernador Leblanche.

programme.title: Al oeste de la división
programme.desc: Ted Hayden se hace pasar por un hombre buscado y se une a la banda de Gentry sólo para enterarse más tarde de que Gentry fue quien mató a su padre. Salva el rancho del padre de Virginia Winters de Gentry y también rescata a su hermano Spud, perdido hace tiempo.

programme.title: Una Trampa del Tiempo
programme.desc: Cada día, Lika está más cerca de resolver el misterio, pero la noche borra de su memoria todo lo que ha descubierto. Un día, finalmente se da cuenta de quién es el asesino, pero con horror comprende que al amanecer lo habrá olvidado…

programme.title: Una Trampa del Tiempo
programme.desc: Lika está a punto de resolver el caso de un psicópata que aterroriza Moscú desde hace seis meses, matando una vez al mes y dejando pistas sobre el paradero de cada víctima. Tras analizar los datos, deduce que la próxima estará en la azotea de un rascacielos inacabado. Ya de noche, llega hasta allí y, justo cuando está a punto de admitir su error, recibe un golpe en la cabeza. Lo último que ve antes de desmayarse es un tablero electrónico gigante marcando las 23:59:59…

programme.title: Una Trampa del Tiempo
programme.desc: Mientras verifica su teoría sobre el posible lugar del próximo asesinato, Besedina llega a un rascacielos abandonado

programme.title: Una Trampa del Tiempo
programme.desc: Tres meses después, Lika despierta en un hospital. Debido a una lesión, su cerebro borra diariamente toda la información adquirida durante el día. Cada jornada, Lika intenta completar el mismo camino: recordar quién es, volver a recopilar todos los datos sobre la serie de asesinatos y lograr identificar al criminal antes de la medianoche.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Las tres reinas: así es como Mikhail Pogodin, director y propietario de una bodega en la ciudad de Chernomorsk, quería nombrar la marca de su nuevo vino, pero no llegó a hacerlo... Fue encontrado muerto en su piso. Viktor, su hijo, regresa a su ciudad natal y decide investigar la causa de la muerte de su padre y salvar el negocio familiar.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Víctor descubre que su padre trabajaba en un vino especial. Mientras tanto, su madrastra Ella es manipulada por su amante para entregar documentos de la bodega. Todo parece indicar un suicidio, pero Víctor no está convencido.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Un experto revela que la nota de despedida de Pogodin es falsa. Víctor busca a un anciano en las montañas para descubrir el secreto del vino "Tres Reinas". Mientras tanto, el vicealcalde ordena vigilarlo de cerca.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Ella intenta sobornar a Víctor para que abandone la investigación. Katya consigue los diarios del padre de Víctor. La prometida de Víctor, Zhenya, llega a la ciudad, pero él se da cuenta de que siempre ha amado a Katya.

programme.desc: Zhenya se alía con Sergey para separar a Katya de Víctor. El detective Litvinov regresa. Sergey droga a Katya y toma fotos comprometedoras. Su padre denuncia su desaparición a la policía.

programme.desc: Víctor ve las fotos y cree que Katya lo traicionó. Ella, en crisis, intenta suicidarse, pero Víctor la salva. Katya logra escapar de Sergey, pero es arrestada tras una orden del vicealcalde.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Daniel Schmidt and Zach Haas dive into the topic of Epizootic Hemorrhagic Disease (EHD), exploring what it is, how it spreads, and the impact it has on whitetail deer populations. Daniel then takes viewers back ten years to a memorable hunt in Kansas where he harvested a buck that had survived EHD. The remarkable deer carried lasting signs of its battle with the disease, including a severely deformed club foot believed to be the result of surviving the infection. This episode offers a fascinating look at deer resilience and provides hunters with a deeper understanding of one of the most significant diseases affecting whitetails today.

programme.title: Winchester Life

The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. This annual father-son trip is built on early mornings, shared stories, and moments that stick with you long after the season ends. It’s the memories made over the years that keep calling them back—and this year will be no different.

From unforgettable hunts and incredible wildlife to evenings around hunting camp with amazing people, this trip was filled with memories that will last a lifetime. A huge thank you to Double T Outfitters for your incredible hospitality and for your continued support of TTHA. Partnerships like yours help make experiences like this possible. This episode is packed with great hunting, genuine friendships, and the stories that make the outdoors so special.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila fiercely defends herself from Roberto's aggression and tells Max what happened. Mother Isabel, to help Camila, confides to Ezequiel why Roberto is extorting her. Max pressures Camila to tell him the whole truth.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Roberto confesses that he was the one who killed Gabriel to frame Camila. Camila cries with joy, knowing she is innocent of that death. Max reiterates his unconditional support, ratifying his great love for her. Ezequiel expresses his intention to marry Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel, rejected by Camila, manipulates her with a new job offer as assistant to his daughter Julia, all to try to get her closer to him. Max trusts in Camila's love. Torrealba asks them to join forces to find Rosa Blanco.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Faced with Ezequiel's intentions, Octavia and Marcelina verbally attack Camila. Max proposes and Camila hesitates but agrees to marry him. At a dinner party, Ezequiel gathers his children and Camila will be the special guest of honor.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: At the dinner, the main topic will be Rosa Blanco. Ezequiel says that this woman was an opportunist who fell in love with and took advantage of his younger brother, Leoncio. Astrid offends by adding that she was a prostitute, guilty of the war between the two families because of her relationship with Augusto Aragón and also with Leoncio López.

Camila protects Chantal, a girl who sells flowers.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Suffering has deep social causes. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains how your physiology is impacted by stress and social determinants.

programme.title: BREAD. AN EVERYDAY MIRACLE

How can traditional bakery skills survive? And how will the future of bread look like?

programme.title: The Luminescence Podcast
programme.desc: The birth control pill changed history—but how does it really work? This episode explores how the pill suppresses ovulation, alters hormone rhythms, and impacts mood, libido, vaginal health, PCOS, and cancer risk. Learn progestin vs. progesterone, what to expect coming off, and how to discuss informed consent.

programme.title: The Luminescence Podcast
programme.desc: Stress can shut down libido by spiking cortisol and pushing your body into survival mode. This episode explains the HPA axis, how chronic stress disrupts sleep, mood, and metabolism, and why desire often reflects nervous system safety. Learn simple resets—breathwork, walking, co-regulation, and better sleep.

programme.title: The Luminescence Podcast
programme.desc: Testosterone isn’t just for men—it fuels women’s energy, muscle, mood, brain function, and libido. This episode unpacks why levels decline, signs of low T, testing basics, and HRT options (creams, gels, injections, pellets), plus risks, benefits, and natural ways to support healthy hormones.

programme.title: The Luminescence Podcast
programme.desc: Intimacy isn’t just penetration or orgasm. This episode redefines pleasure through connection, consent, kink wisdom, and communication. She discusses her new book, Whole Brain Living: The Anatomy of Choice and the Four Characteristics that Drive Our Life.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Professor Robert Thurman, the preeminent scholar and interpreter of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy for the modern world, who believes that Wisdom is Bliss and in fact, that’s the name of his latest book. Thurman is a very close friend of HH Dalai Lama and today he discusses deep ideas about mindfulness and presence and leads us on a joyful exploration into the nature of reality through Buddha’s threefold curriculum.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Harley Rotbart, a nationally renowned infectious diseases specialist, pediatrician, parenting expert, speaker, and educator who discusses his latest book No Regrets Parenting: Turning Long Days and Short Years into Cherished Moments with Your Kids. He shares special keys for parents to guide children to live a life of wonder and contentment by conscious parenting.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews marital and family psychologist Dr. Michael Tobin who believes the secret to a happy, long-lasting relationship is mutual respect for one another. He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. James Greenblatt, a pioneer in the field of integrative medicine who has been treating patients with eating disorders for many decades. His nutritional approach to psychiatry is revolutionary and has helped patients worldwide. He is the author of seven books, including Answers to Anorexia and Finally Focused: The Breakthrough Natural Treatment Plan for ADHD.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Definitive statements are comforting. They give life structure and clear direction. But what happens when your declarations are at odds with your subconscious desires?

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Today's lesson is a bit of a reality check, as we'll begin to question the current way we look at relationships, romantic or not. How we see ourselves and our relationship to God influences our view of our relationships with other people. Today we're going to examine that view from a place of love.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: A miracle happens when you stop thinking with fear and start thinking with love. Your greatest power lies in your mind. To establish stronger connections, you need to go into every situation requesting to be an instrument of love. When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: In the following lesson, we'll discover how the ego mind influences both our way of thinking and our relationships. We'll also identify the unconscious barriers we've built that cause us to form these judgments and thoughts. That's where the problem is, and that's where the solution lies.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: The focus of today's lecture is this: atonement. While we decided to act a certain way in the past based on our personality, we can now use this information to improve our current and future relationships.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: To truly grasp the concept of forgiveness, we have to be willing to see past the person's mistakes. The benefit we get from being more forgiving isn't that other people are going to be more forgiving towards us, it's that it won't affect us when they aren't.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: In this lesson, we'll discover the significance of holy relationships. After all, souls are brought together for the purpose of enlightenment.

programme.title: Road To Dharma

programme.title: Road To Dharma

programme.title: Road To Dharma

programme.title: Road To Dharma

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: Blondie -- Live in London 2014

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Host Joel Madden sits down with Matt Pryor, vocalist and guitarist of The Get Up Kids, for a conversation about van touring in the ’90s, being labeled “emo,” and how those early years shaped his approach to songwriting. Pryor also discusses his new book, Red Letter Days, capturing life on the road, family, and creativity through the lens of an evolving music scene.

programme.title: Every Other Summer
programme.desc: Every Other Summer is a documentary about Solid Sound Festival by Wilco. Shot in 2013, it features performances by Wilco, Neko Case, and others.

programme.title: Foxing: Live at The Grandel
programme.desc: Foxing performs 'Draw Down The Moon' for 'Live At The Grandel' Album. Filmed at The Grandel in St. Louis, MO.

programme.title: Phantogram: 'Running Through Colors' Tour Live in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Phantogram performs a sold-out show at the Hollywood Palladium, delivering a dynamic live set from their Running Through Colors tour.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden interviews Hongjoong of ATEEZ on life as a K-pop artist and Korea's global cultural influence.

programme.title: Jonathan Van Ness Stand-Up Special: Fun & Slutty
programme.desc: Jonathan Van Ness performs his debut stand-up special in his hometown, Austin, TX, blending comedy, sex-ed themes, and audience interaction.

programme.title: Queen: From Rags to Rhapsody
programme.desc: This documentary tells the story of Queen’s journey from a struggling band to the moment they captured the UK’s hearts with what was to become the greatest song.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with comedian and host Jessi Cruickshank for a fast, funny conversation about boy-band fandom, parenting twins (and a third kid), and finding sanity on tour. They swap stories on public-parent life, the joys and chaos of twinhood, and how identity, confidence, and career evolve with family.

programme.title: Porno for Pyros: Horns, Thorns En Halos Farewell Tour Live from Los Angeles
programme.desc: Porno for Pyros take the stage one final time for their Horns, Thorns En Halos Farewell Tour, performing live from The Belasco Theater in Los Angeles. Frontman Perry Farrell, guitarist Peter DiStefano, drummer Stephen Perkins, and bassist Martyn LeNoble deliver an electrifying and emotional performance that spans their entire career — from hits like Pets and Tahitian Moon to deep cuts and spoken interludes that showcase their surreal, art-rock energy. Captured exclusively on Veeps, this farewell show celebrates three decades of psychedelic alternative rock and the enduring chemistry that defined the band’s sound.

programme.title: Audioslave: Live In Cuba
programme.desc: Filmed at The Anti-Imperialist Plaza in Havana in 2005, Audioslave's Live in Cuba features hits from the band's three albums plus hits from Soundgarden and Rage Against the Machine.

programme.title: Mt. Joy: Live from Red Rocks Night 1
programme.desc: Mt. Joy kicks off the first of two sold-out nights at the legendary Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Morrison, Colorado. Captured live by Veeps, the set blends fan-favorite hits and new unreleased tracks in a high-energy performance that showcases the band’s signature mix of soaring vocals and indie-rock warmth. Highlights include “Lemon Tree,” “Highway Queen,” and a special collaboration on “Lake Missoula” featuring Richy Mitch & The Coal Miners. A powerful opening night that sets the tone for a weekend of unforgettable music under the stars.

programme.title: +LIVE + from The Jubilee Tour
programme.desc: Iconic rock band +LIVE+ celebrates the 30th anniversary of their breakthrough album Throwing Copper with a powerful performance on The Jubilee Tour in Noblesville, Indiana. The set features career-spanning hits including “All Over You,” “Pain Lies on the Riverside,” “The Dolphin’s Cry,” and new single “Lady Bang” featuring Dean DeLeo of Stone Temple Pilots.

programme.title: All Things Must Pass
programme.desc: Colin Hanks explores Tower Records' history, from its rise and fall to the legacy of Russ Solomon.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Entrepreneur and author Vishen Lakhiani, founder and CEO of Mindvalley, joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on mindfulness, compassion, and redefining success. Together they explore meditation, conscious living, and how self-awareness and emotional intelligence can transform relationships, business, and personal growth.

programme.title: Michael Clifford: SIDEQUEST LIVE from The Fonda Theatre
programme.desc: Michael Clifford performs his new album SIDEQUEST live at Los Angeles’ historic Fonda Theatre—an intimate, high-energy set with fan interactions, fresh arrangements, and onstage moments with his band. Stream exclusively on Veeps: each PPV ticket includes a 48-hour viewing window; All Access members get extended viewing.

programme.title: DEVO: 50 Years of De-Evolution…Live!
programme.desc: DEVO performs at Denver’s Mission Ballroom, blending art, technology, and attitude in a high-energy live show.

programme.title: AJ Rafael: Take Me Back Tour From Gramercy Theatre
programme.desc: Experience AJ Rafael’s heartfelt “Take Me Back Tour” live from New York City’s Gramercy Theatre. Blending nostalgia and artistry, AJ performs fan favorites and new tracks including “Take Me Back,” “Showstopper,” and “I Just Want You.” Through soulful storytelling, intimate moments, and emotional performances, AJ reflects on his journey from the early Myspace and YouTube days to becoming one of the most beloved independent singer-songwriters of his generation.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Andrew McMahon discusses his journey in music, from being a child to an artist, and his experience with Drive Through Records.

programme.title: Waterparks: FANDOM Live in the UK
programme.desc: A kinetic concert film captured at a sold-out O2 Academy Birmingham (Jan 2020), where Waterparks perform FANDOM through an alternate-universe lens. Executive producers Awsten Knight and Jawn Rocha fuse practical and special effects so every song looks the way it feels on stage—euphoric, chaotic, and intimate. Setlist highlights include crowd-igniting moments like “Dream Boy,” “High Definition,” “Dizzy,” and more, with circle pits, call-and-response, and fourth-wall breaks as the band records a live CD/DVD with the audience.

programme.title: Incubus: The Morning View Sessions
programme.desc: The Morning View Sessions captures Incubus' fourth album release day. Features live hits Nice to Know You, Wish You Were Here, Warning, and Circles.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: In this moving conversation, Dayseeker frontman Rory Rodriguez joins Joel Madden to open up about therapy, grief, and fatherhood. Rory shares how losing his father and becoming one himself reshaped his life, how trauma informed his music, and how therapy helped him rediscover balance. A candid look at vulnerability, resilience, and creative healing through pain and art.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum rapper/producer G-Eazy sits down with Joel Madden to talk brotherhood, the early grind, and returning to the road after a six-year hiatus. From funny tangents (the philosophy of milkshakes) to reflective moments about not fitting in growing up, finding belonging in music, and dedicating part of his show to his late mom, Gerald shares why performing completes the art—and how a whirlwind London stop let him share the stage with his brother James. He also recalls his first runs back (including arena-scale crowds in India) and the community that’s formed around his all-black stage persona.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Two-time Grammy-nominated rapper/singer Morray sits down with Joel Madden to talk fatherhood, faith, and the mindset behind his comeback album Long Story Short after a four-year break. From punctuality and work ethic to money, power, and paying it forward, Morray shares how joy, transparency, and community keep him grounded. He reflects on collaborating with J. Cole (crafting hooks together, studio precision), sharing stages with Cole and 21 Savage, and growing up in Fayetteville, NC.

programme.title: Nick Swardson: Make Joke from Face
programme.desc: Nick Swardson delivers a stand-up special filled with outrageous stories, sharp humor, and reflections on life, fame, and misadventures.

programme.title: Nos Amis
programme.desc: Nos Amis follows Eagles of Death Metal members Jesse Hughes and Josh Homme as they recount their experiences before, during, and after the 2015 terrorist attack at the Bataclan Theatre in Paris. Blending intimate interviews, archival footage, and emotional reflection, the documentary explores trauma, friendship, and the unifying power of rock and roll.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Legendary songwriter Linda Perry discusses her career, childhood, and new documentary and album with Joel.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Sleep Theory frontman Cullen Moore joins Joel Madden to talk about his journey from serving in the U.S. Army to fronting one of modern rock’s fastest-rising bands. Moore reflects on his Memphis roots, discovering his sound, and how TikTok helped launch Sleep Theory to viral success. The two explore discipline, creativity, and how music became Moore’s true “Plan A.”

programme.title: Urzila Carlson: It’s Personal
programme.desc: Urzila Carlson performs her stand-up special filmed in Brisbane, delivering sharp humor and personal stories from her global tour.

programme.title: Good Charlotte: Live at Brixton Academy
programme.desc: Good Charlotte performs live at Brixton Academy, delivering hits from The Young and the Hopeless in a high-energy concert.

programme.title: Carmen Christopher: Live from the Windy City
programme.desc: Comedian Carmen Christopher returns home to Chicago for a sharp, surreal, and hilarious stand-up special that blends the absurd with the heartfelt. With quick wit and offbeat honesty, Christopher riffs on social media, family, dating, politics, and Midwest life in a performance that’s both painfully self-aware and laugh-out-loud ridiculous. Executive produced by Tim Robinson and Zach Kanin.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Travie McCoy discusses his gradual rise in music, from humble beginnings to headlining. He shares a metaphor from his album cover and tells a story about breaking his neck riding a dirt bike.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Daryl Palumbo of Glassjaw and Head Automatica. Daryl reflects on three decades of genre-defying music, the freedom he’s always pursued as an artist, the self-doubt and restlessness that shaped his work, and how fatherhood became the most grounding and fulfilling experience of his life.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: James Taylor: Live at the Beacon Theatre
programme.desc: James Taylor performs live at the Beacon Theatre, delivering songs from Hourglass alongside classics in a special concert featuring unseen footage.

programme.title: Anthony Green: So Long, Avalon Live In New York
programme.desc: Experience Anthony Green live from the Gramercy Theatre in New York as he celebrates the release of So Long, Avalon. An intimate, high–energy set blends new material with fan favorites, spontaneous crowd moments, and a playful nod to classic “Kokomo.” Green spotlights his touring band — Greg Mervine (drums), Sean Cohen (multi-instrumentalist), Dave Davison, and Keith Goodwin — and shouts out friends Kurt Travis and Geoff Rickly for helping shape a special night. A dynamic performance that captures Green’s voice, humor, and gratitude in a room full of true believers.

programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: SPIN x Fire: Free Speech + Other Dirty Words
programme.desc: Hear Morello discuss his message and mission in Free Speech + Other Dirty Words, presented by SPIN and the FIRE, and hosted by Ryan Downey.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: Folk Metal Forest Feast
programme.desc: Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Thrash Metal Attack
programme.desc: Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

programme.title: The Home of Heavy
programme.desc: Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: Together We Rise
programme.desc: A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts Part 2
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium; Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebrides, Op. 26; Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16.

programme.title: Noseda Conducts Liszt, Strauss and Rota
programme.desc: Nino Rota aims to give everyone a moment of happiness; his "Third Symphony" sparkles with Italian sunlight.

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.

programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programme.desc: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.

programme.title: Puccini - La Boheme
programme.desc: In 2012, Norwegian opera director Stefan Herheim brought Giacomo Puccini's opera La bohème to the stage of the Norwegian National Opera in Oslo; Norwegian conductor Eivind Gullberg Jensen leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the National Opera Oslo.

programme.title: Works by Mendelssohn & Hensel
programme.desc: A 2020 performance of Mendelssohn and Hensel at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Germany.

programme.title: Berlioz
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz's "Symphonie," Op. 14; this performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Mikhail Pletnev Conducts Rimski-Korsakov
programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music.

programme.title: Faure's Requiem
programme.desc: Winchester Cathedral Orchestra and the English Chamber Choir perform the piece; host John Gielgud.

programme.title: Chopin: Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.

programme.title: Beethoven Symphony No. 2 in D Major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris record Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto & Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy.

programme.title: Sibelius, Mendelssohn & Saariaho
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

programme.title: Symphonies Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhausorchester; recorded in Leipzig's Gewandhaus.

programme.title: Berlioz
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz's "Symphonie," Op. 14; this performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: Iconic music from movies and series such as "Babylon Berlin" and "The Great Gatsby."

programme.title: Liszt's Concerto No. 1 & Mahler's Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Michael Tilson Thomas conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Mahler's Fifth Symphony; Lukáš Vondráček is the soloist in Liszt's First Piano Concerto.

programme.title: Mahler, The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Leonard Bernstein was the first conductor to record all of Mahler's symphonies on disk and on video.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna from Vienna's Café Sperl; the ensemble consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic.

programme.title: Mahler, The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Leonard Bernstein was the first conductor to record all of Mahler's symphonies on disk and on video.

programme.title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.

programme.title: Gershwin's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: A firework display with music from Hollywood films.

programme.title: Works for Lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017.
